tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show how many lookups the API key has left, plus recharge_url and dashboard_url. Free (does not use a credit). Use before a large batch.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_tech_stack · Private data: lookup_tech_stack, check_credits · Public sink: lookup_tech_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_tech_stack · Private data: lookup_tech_stack, check_credits · Public sink: lookup_tech_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
